`command.go` [command.go:1098-1119](file:///home/andy/cogz_bench/replay_tmp/cogz_replay_24ada7fe_0bxp2v43/command.go): In `ExecuteC`, moved `InitDefaultCompletionCmd` and `checkCommandGroups` after `initCompleteCmd(args)`, and passed the resolved args to `InitDefaultCompletionCmd(args...)` — so it can tell whether `completion` is actually being invoked.
